metaDescription: Raymond Hardin has been installing and repairing roofs in East Texas for over 38 years (since age 17) and founded Raymond Hardin Roofing in 1995. Licensed, bonded, insured & BBB Accredited.
title: About Raymond Hardin Roofing
intro: Family-owned in Gilmer since 1995. He started roofing at 17 and has been on East Texas roofs for more than 38 years.
extraParagraph: We install and repair shingle, metal, and torch-down rubber roofs, including tear-offs and re-decks. The estimate is written before the work starts. We pull the permits and stay with you while an insurance payment is pending.
photoAlt: A shingle roof installed by Raymond Hardin Roofing
chooseIntro: Ask these before you let someone on the roof.

chooseItems.question: How much experience does the roofer have, and with which materials?
chooseItems.answer: Raymond Hardin has been on East Texas roofs for more than 38 years, working with shingle, metal, and torch-down rubber.

chooseItems.question: Is the roofer licensed, bonded, and insured?
chooseItems.answer: Raymond Hardin Roofing is licensed, bonded, insured, and a BBB Accredited business.

chooseItems.question: Can they show you finished work?
chooseItems.answer: Ask to see roofs they have already done, and for customers you can call.

chooseItems.question: What do other people say?
chooseItems.answer: Read the Better Business Bureau listing and the reviews from people in East Texas.

chooseItems.question: Are they pushing you to sign after a storm?
chooseItems.answer: Do not sign a contract or pay anyone who shows up at the door promising to fix the roof. Check who they are first.

chooseItems.question: Can they explain the materials and the warranty?
chooseItems.answer: A roofer should be able to tell you the tradeoffs of the material, what the manufacturer warranty covers, and what they stand behind.

chooseItems.question: Is the lowest price the right one?
chooseItems.answer: A cheap job from an inexperienced crew can cost more later. Hire the contractor whose work and reputation you trust.
